instruction: Triage this batch of customer support emails: assign each email to exactly one support category by its primary intent.

emails.subject: Export: broken or intended?
emails.body: csv egress on big reprots errrors out evry time — intended or broke? never completes for us

emails.subject: Wrong SKU sent
emails.body: you shiped the wrong unit, pls send the corect one — can sort the price diff after, priority is the right item

emails.subject: Totals look wrong
emails.body: weekly totals lookd wrong so we thot bug, but the numbrs r right — we jst dont get how yr 'week' is defined, explain the rollup?

emails.subject: Quarter recap, one real ask
emails.body: busy qtr, team loved the dashbaord, admin re-added 2 seats (sorted) — real ask: our renewal invoce has a mid-term price hike we never agreed to, pls explain n correct the pricing

emails.subject: Several threads, one urgent
emails.body: hw add-on shiped late (resolved), someone askd about pdf export (no rush) — URGENT: since tues release the login page errors for ALL our users, nobody can get in, its on yr side, P1 pls

emails.body: splitting into 2 regional teams, ill get new invoces n the new hires want a walkthru later — rn what i need: move 8 users from the EMEA org to a new APAC org n set their manager, pure acct-structure change

emails.subject: Long complaint, real blocker
emails.body: support was slow, app logged me out twice (back in fine), still dont get the new bill line — but whats blocking us: the replacment device promised for mon still isnt here, its thurs no trackign, where is it?

emails.subject: Reads like a bug, is a how-to
emails.body: analysts flagd reporting as 'broken' cuz numbers dont add up — dug in, not a defect, figures r correct — we jst need to understand how yr rollups define a week n the cutoff, no fix needed
